verdict.rationale: Exporting data is a fair question for a compliance SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no full-account export or open-format export, and nothing describing an offboarding or data-portability flow. The GraphQL Developer API and its introspection are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, and 'audit-ready reports' is an adjacent reporting feature; neither counts as a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
